name: Crimson Nights
source:
Eternal life, enhanced abilities, and… navigating relationships? This is your life as a vampire.

You wake up changed- you’re a vampire now. Journey through your small town by night, learning what new powers you have, fending off your thirst for human blood, and avoiding dangerous vampire hunters. Most importantly, you have the chance to get to know and romance the two lovely ladies in your life, in this sapphic, supernatural dating sim!

[from [url=https://starishsky.itch.io/crimson-nights]itch.io[/url]]
